description: This file is a PHP source code for a web configuration wizard page that allows users to configure Wi-Fi networks (both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz), including network names, security modes, and passwords. It includes PHP logic, embedded JavaScript for form handling and validation, and HTML markup for the user interface.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to the server via AJAX to save the settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data and calls set_config to save Wi-Fi network settings.
